_comment: `vendor` is a code splitting group with `a.js` and `w.js`. `main.js` defers `a.js`, and `b.js` imports `a.js`, then `w.js`. The chunk of a group does not move its modules to a new chunk, so the chunk runs `a.js` at load, at its place, as the build without `import defer` does. `a.js` has a top-level `await`, so the chunk awaits the init function of `a.js`.
